title: Isandro and the Salt
author: Ansel Ishikawa
blurb: Orsen Coldharbour, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
